title: A workout or diet plan sent to a whole membership plan pops up only for members on that plan on the day it is saved
what: When the owner sends a workout or diet plan to everyone on a membership plan, the phone pop-up goes only to members whose membership covers that very day. A member whose plan starts tomorrow, who renews after a gap, or who joins that plan next week gets the workout or diet plan in the app later, but never a pop-up. Nothing tells the owner this.
expected: A member who comes onto the plan later is told once that a gym workout or diet plan is waiting for them, or the owner is told the pop-up only reaches members on the plan today.
how_often: every new or renewed member of a plan that already has a gym plan
fix_line: Also send the pop-up when a member's membership of that plan starts

title: The gym's reply to a member message shows its words in the pop-up on a locked phone
what: When the gym replies in Message your gym, the member's pop-up carries the first 150 letters of the reply. A reply to a complaint or a private question can be read by anyone who sees the locked phone. The gym's own alerts to staff deliberately never show the message words.
expected: The pop-up says the gym replied and to open the app to read it, the same care the staff alerts take.
fix_line: Leave the reply words out of the pop-up

items.reason: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: member pop-ups on OPPO/Xiaomi/Samsung with battery saver and screen off (sound, banner, auto-start), staff browser alerts on Android Chrome with the tab closed and on iPhone (works only once added to the home screen), and whether member pop-ups show on a paired watch
